title: GSTR-1 export — as built by Gstr1JsonExporter
description: NOT the GSTN schema. This is a lock on the shape THIS codebase emits, so an accidental field rename, retype or omission in Gstr1JsonExporter fails a test instead of being discovered by the portal. Checkpoint C5.1 asks for validation against the authoritative GSTN schema, which is not in this repository (open-questions.md #23); when it arrives it goes in this folder as gstr1-gstn.schema.json and gets its own test. Field names marked CONFIRMED were matched against two independent published references to the GSTN payload during the C5.1 review; those marked UNVERIFIED are this codebase's own reading and are recorded in #23 as probably wrong.

version.description: The pinned GSTN schema version this file was written for (spec §2).

gstin.description: CONFIRMED. The filer's own GSTIN, in the statutory 15-character form.

fp.description: CONFIRMED. Filing period. April-based financial year as FY-begin year + FY-end two digits, e.g. 202627.

gen_dt.description: UNVERIFIED (#23). Generation timestamp. Written as an ISO-8601 round-trip string; the portal's own gen_dt is a dd-mm-yyyy date.

gtotals.description: UNVERIFIED (#23). Grand totals block. The portal carries gt / cur_gt (gross turnover) at this level instead.

b2b.description: CONFIRMED. Registered-buyer supplies, grouped by counterparty GSTIN.

b2c.description: UNVERIFIED (#23). Unregistered-buyer supplies, nested by place of supply. The portal's equivalent is a FLAT b2cs array, and inter-state B2C invoices above the invoice-wise threshold belong in a b2cl section this exporter does not emit at all.

hsn.description: CONFIRMED (section name and the data array). Table 12 HSN summary.

amount.description: Rupees at two decimal places. Converted from integer minor units exactly once, in the exporter (ADR-0003).

csamt.description: CONFIRMED as csamt. This was emitted as csft until the C5.1 review, which the portal would not have recognised — cess would have filed as nil.

rchrg.description: CONFIRMED. Reverse charge, Y or N.

invoiceItem.description: CONFIRMED. The portal nests each rate line's figures under itm_det alongside a 1-based num; this exporter wrote the figures flat until the C5.1 review.

rt.description: CONFIRMED. Rate as a percentage, e.g. 18 for 18%.

cnt.description: UNVERIFIED (#23). Invoice count. Not a field of the portal's b2cs section.

hsn_sc.description: CONFIRMED as hsn_sc. Emitted as hsn until the C5.1 review.

desc.description: Omitted entirely when the master carries no description.

uqc.description: UNVERIFIED (#23). Unit quantity code — hardcoded to NOS, so an item sold in any other unit reports the wrong UQC.

sply_ty.description: UNVERIFIED (#23). The Table 12 B2B/B2C split this build writes.
